_meta.name: Checkpoint + CLIP skip 2 (Pony / NoobAI)
_meta.description: Same as the plain checkpoint preset, with a CLIPSetLastLayer node set to -2 ("CLIP skip 2"), which Pony Diffusion V6 XL requires and many NoobAI / anime SDXL merges prefer. Defaults follow the Pony model card: Euler a, 25 steps, 1024 px.
notes: Identical to txt2img_checkpoint.json except node 10 (CLIPSetLastLayer, stop_at_clip_layer -2) sits between the checkpoint's CLIP output and both CLIPTextEncode nodes.
Pony V6 wants its quality tags at the front of the prompt: pick the 'Pony score tags' style, or type them yourself (score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, ...).
For CLIP skip 1 use the plain checkpoint preset; for other values edit stop_at_clip_layer (-1 = no skip, -2 = skip 2, ...).
requires: ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/<a Pony, NoobAI or other SDXL checkpoint>.safetensors

defaults.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, blurry
